first.summary: A modular actor component providing damage mitigation, healing over time, and replicated death events for co-op action RPGs.

modules.name: DamageReceiver
modules.description: Handles incoming damage calculations and mitigation.

modules.name: DeathHandler
modules.description: Triggers death events and state cleanup.

modules.name: ArmorMitigation
modules.description: Reduces incoming damage based on armor stats.

first.blueprint_pseudocode:
Event BeginPlay
  -> Set CurrentHealth = MaxHealth
  WHY: Ensures the owner always spawns at full health without relying on default property serialization order.
  -> Bind OnTakeAnyDamage -> ApplyDamage
  WHY: Centralizes damage intake through the component to trigger armor reduction and death checks cleanly.

setup_guide.title: Create Component
setup_guide.detail: Create a new ActorComponent derived from HealthAndDamageComponent.
setup_guide.why: Encapsulates health state cleanly away from character movement logic.

setup_guide.title: Attach to Character
setup_guide.detail: Add the HealthAndDamageComponent to your base RPG character blueprint.
setup_guide.why: Allows any character subclass to automatically inherit health and damage.

setup_guide.title: Configure Defaults
setup_guide.detail: Set MaxHealth and HealTickRate in the component defaults panel.
setup_guide.why: Exposes designer tuning parameters directly in the editor details view.

setup_guide.title: Bind Death Event
setup_guide.detail: Bind to OnDeath in your character blueprint to handle ragdoll or respawn.
setup_guide.why: Decouples health tracking from specific death visual implementations.

first.network_notes: Non-replicated component intended for offline or authoritative single-player calculations within the action RPG architecture.

ctx.prompt: A health and damage component with heal over time and a death event

second.summary: A fully replicated modular actor component providing shield absorption, armor mitigation, heal over time, and gameplay tag-based death handling for co-op action RPGs.

modules.name: DamageReceiver
modules.description: Removed in favor of direct component-level RPC damage routing.

modules.name: ShieldAbsorb
modules.description: Absorbs incoming damage onto temporary energy shields before health is depleted.

modules.name: HealOverTime
modules.description: Handles periodic regeneration ticks via timer handles.

modules.name: DeathHandler
modules.description: Manages death state transitions using native Gameplay Tags.

modules.name: ArmorMitigation
modules.description: Mitigates incoming raw damage values using a flat or percentage armor formula.

second.blueprint_pseudocode:
Event BeginPlay
  -> Set CurrentHealth = MaxHealth
  WHY: Ensures server authority initializes health properly upon game start.
  -> Set GameplayTagContainer.AddTag(State.Normal)
  WHY: Initializes character state cleanly using native Gameplay Tags instead of boolean flags.
  -> Bind OnRep_CurrentHealth -> UpdateUI
  WHY: Synchronizes health changes across network clients reliably.

setup_guide.title: Enable Component Replication
setup_guide.detail: Set Replicates to true in the component properties.
setup_guide.why: Ensures health and shield state replicates properly across clients in co-op.

setup_guide.title: Attach to RPG Character
setup_guide.detail: Add ReplicatedHealthComponent to the base multiplayer character blueprint.
setup_guide.why: Standardizes health handling across all player-controlled actors.

setup_guide.title: Configure Tunables
setup_guide.detail: Set Max Health to 200.0 and configure Shield Amount in editor defaults.

setup_guide.title: Setup Gameplay Tags
setup_guide.detail: Create and assign State.Normal and State.Dead gameplay tags.
setup_guide.why: Replaces fragile boolean flags with robust tag-based state containers.

setup_guide.title: Bind UI Delegates
setup_guide.detail: Bind OnHealthChanged and OnShieldChanged to widget HUD update functions.
setup_guide.why: Keeps health bars synchronized with server state without polling.

second.network_notes: Fully network replicated component using DOREPLIFETIME and OnRep notification functions to keep health, max health, and shields synchronized across all co-op clients.
applied_changes: Designer note: Use a Gameplay Tag for the dead state instead of a bool
